key_points: Elon Musk exercised 2018 stock options, directly increasing Tesla's ownership base and shareholder value
SpaceX merger buzz is creating a strong near-term narrative tailwind for TSLA
Q2 capex exceeded street estimates, providing growth justification amid market concerns
FSD faces regulatory roadblocks (Sweden opposition to EU-wide approval), posing execution risk
Premarket rebound reflects positive market reaction to these catalysts
